xc_amorium_postc.content:

    fields:
        form_name:
            label: Form Name
            tab: Content
            type: text
            translatable: false
            required: true
            placeholder: Newsletter, Contact Us, Comment...
            comment: Submissions are listed and filtered by this name in the Forms menu. Use the same name on every page where the same form is used.

        subtitle:
            label: Subtitle
            tab: Content
            type: text
            span: left
            default: Contact us

        title:
            label: Title
            tab: Content
            type: text
            span: right
            default: Get In Touch !

        description:
            label: Description
            tab: Content
            type: richeditor
            size: small

        image:
            label: Image
            tab: Content
            type: mediafinder
            mode: image
            maxItems: 1
            span: left
            comment: When an image is chosen, the image and the form are shown side by side and the fields are placed one under another.

        image_position:
            label: Image Position
            tab: Content
            type: dropdown
            span: right
            default: left
            options:
                left: Left
                right: Right

        fields:
            label: Form Fields
            tab: Form Fields
            type: repeater
            prompt: Add field
            titleFrom: label
            itemsExpanded: false
            default:
                - label: Name
                  type: text
                  required: true
                  width: half
                - label: Email
                  type: email
                  required: true
                  width: half
                - label: Message
                  type: textarea
                  required: true
                  width: full
            form:
                fields:
                    label:
                        label: Label
                        type: text
                        span: left

                    type:
                        label: Type
                        type: dropdown
                        span: right
                        default: text
                        options:
                            text: Text
                            email: Email
                            number: Number
                            textarea: Textarea
                            select: Select Box
                            radio: Radio Buttons
                            checkbox: Checkboxes

                    placeholder:
                        label: Placeholder
                        type: text
                        comment: For select boxes this is shown as the empty first option.
                        trigger:
                            action: show
                            field: type
                            condition: value[text][email][number][textarea][select]

                    options:
                        label: Options
                        type: textarea
                        size: small
                        comment: One option per line. Leave empty on a checkbox to show a single checkbox, for example to accept terms.
                        trigger:
                            action: show
                            field: type
                            condition: value[select][radio][checkbox]

                    required:
                        label: Required
                        type: switch
                        span: left

                        label: Width
                        type: dropdown
                        span: right
                        default: full
                        options:
                            full: Full width
                            half: Half width

            type: text
            span: left

            span: right
